description.text: Inside a cramped garage, tool carts, coiled hoses and crowded shelving press close around a half-stripped engine mounted on a stand. The engine block is dark with oil, and a worn drive belt hangs exposed near its front. The older mechanic, in a stained work shirt, leans over the block from the left, one hand braced on the engine stand and the other lifted. Across the engine bay, the younger mechanic holds a rag and watches him. Work lamps throw a warm, hard light across greasy metal and concrete, leaving the corners of the garage in shadow. The older man presses a fingertip to the worn belt and speaks with a flat, set expression, his jaw tight. The younger man straightens from the fender, rag hanging from his fingers, and holds his ground without answering yet. The room's faint electrical hum sits under the tap of the belt.
The cramped garage is packed with tool carts, hanging hoses and crowded shelving around a half-stripped engine on a stand.
The older mechanic leans over the block and taps the worn drive belt; the younger mechanic straightens from the fender with a rag in hand.
A fingertip taps a rubber belt, a dry thump beneath the garage room tone.
The older mechanic keeps his jaw set as he speaks, while the younger man holds his ground without answering.
A faint electrical hum drifts through the garage.

The younger mechanic fills the foreground beside the engine bay, wiping his hands slowly on the rag. Behind him, the older mechanic's shoulder and the edge of the dark engine block remain in frame. The younger man meets the older man's stare, lifts his chin and answers back with a short, defiant line, the rag still moving across his palms. The older mechanic exhales through his nose and gives a small, tired shake of the head, his shoulder shifting against the light. Oil-dark metal, the stained cloth and the dim garage walls keep the space tight around them.
The younger mechanic fills the foreground, wiping his hands on a rag beside the engine bay, with the older mechanic's shoulder and the engine block behind him.
Cloth rasps softly as the rag passes over the younger mechanic's hands.
The younger mechanic meets the older man's stare, lifts his chin and answers back; the older man exhales and shakes his head.
A short exhale escapes through the nose over the low garage hum.
The older mechanic's shoulder shifts as his headshake settles, and the younger man keeps the rag moving.

summary.text: Two mechanics argue over a half-stripped engine in a cramped, tool-cluttered garage; the older man taps a worn belt and delivers a flat verdict, and the younger man wipes his hands and pushes back.

speakers.description: An older mechanic with a weathered face, grease-stained hands and a stained work shirt.
A younger mechanic with short hair, a work shirt and a rag in his hand.

claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
The older mechanic wears a stained work shirt and leans over a half-stripped engine on a stand with a worn drive belt.
The younger mechanic holds a rag on the far side of the engine bay.
The garage walls are crowded with tools, hoses and shelving, lit by work lamps.
The exchange is staged as a tense standoff, with the older mechanic tapping the belt and the younger mechanic wiping his hands before pushing back.

soundscape: Garage room tone with a faint electrical hum, a fingertip tap on a rubber belt, the soft rasp of cloth, and a short exhale.
